---
applyTo: "site/**"
---

Compiled site lane only.

- Home is `site/index.html` (Window). Board is `site/board.html`.
- `public_dns=off`. Do not enable GitHub Pages or public DNS unless Robert says so.
- Prefer ADD/EXTEND over delete. Smallest HTML/CSS/JS change that still works.
- Do not put clinical notes, passwords, tokens, Fun-vault paths, or Jim letter body in HTML.
- Do not invent Jira writes, Gemini sync, or Meta product sync on these pages.
